output.subject: Your questions about dark mode and a balance widget
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for getting in touch, and for your kind words about the app. It's lovely to hear that you're enjoying it.

You asked two questions. The first was whether there are any plans for a dark mode in the app. The second was whether there could be a widget that shows your balance without you needing to log in. Thank you for taking the time to share these ideas with us.

We've passed both of your questions to our Digital Banking team, who look after the app, so they can review them. We'll come back to you with a response within 10 business days.

Thank you again for your feedback. It's always good to hear what our customers would like to see, and we appreciate you letting us know what's working well for you, too.

Kind regards,
Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: This is a feature question with a compliment, not a complaint. Decide whether to answer it directly now instead of sending a holding reply.
Check with Digital Banking whether anything about dark mode plans can be shared with customers.
A balance widget that works without logging in raises security considerations. Decide how to address this before giving any answer.
Make sure the final reply does not promise or suggest that either feature will be delivered unless that has been confirmed.
